```yaml
name: PR Commit Security Scan

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  brin-security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run Brin security scan
        id: brin_scan
        run: npx brin --pr ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --token ${{ secrets.BRIN_API_TOKEN }}

      - name: Get Brin scan results
        id: get_brin_results
        run: echo "::set-output name=results::${{ steps.brin_scan.outputs.results }}"

      - name: Comment on PR with Brin results
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          message: |
            ### Brin Security Scan Results
            ${{
              fromJSON(steps.get_brin_results.outputs.results)
                .map(result => `- **Commit:** ${result.commit} - **Score:** ${result.score} - **Status:** ${result.status}`)
                .join('\n')
            }}
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          mode: append

      - name: Remove PR comment when clean
        if: ${{ steps.get_brin_results.outputs.results === '{}' }}
        run: |
          echo "No commits require action. Removing previous comment."
          gh pr comment ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --delete-comment ${{ env.COMMENT_ID }}

      - name: Fail check if any commit is dangerous
        if: ${{ contains(fromJSON(steps.get_brin_results.outputs.results).map(result => result.status), 'dangerous') }}
        run: exit 1
```
